title: 748. Shortest Completing Word

examples.explanation: licensePlate contains letters 's', 'p', 's' (ignoring case), and 't'. "step" contains 't' and 'p', but only contains 1 's'. "steps" contains 't', 'p', and both 's' characters. "stripe" is missing an 's'. "stepple" is missing an 's'. Since "steps" is the only word containing all the letters, that is the answer.

licensePlate only contains the letter 's'. All the words contain 's', but among these "pest", "stew", and "show" are shortest. The answer is "pest" because it is the word that appears earliest of the 3.
